intro.text: The son of a lumberer on Yolen, whose story Wit tells Dalinar.

items.text: A king who believed anyone could achieve great things if given the chance chose Jerick for his intelligence, to prove what the lower classes were capable of in a contest.
Jerick passed every trial until the last, when he fled to war instead of appearing. He then returned and led a coup, killing several of the city-state's barons; how it ended is unknown.
